sentences.text:
3. A preliminary objection has been raised by Sri Vibhu Rai, learned counsel for respondent-Nagar Nigam that against the order cancelling the F.S.S. Registration Certificate, there is a statutory remedy of appeal under Regulation 2.1.12 of Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations 2011.
4.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The aforesaid fact is not disputed by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

5. Since, there is statutory remedy of filingappeal under Regulation 2.1.12 of Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations 2011 against the ordercancelling the F.S.S. Registration Certificate, therefore, present petition is not maintainable before this Court.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 6. Consequently, the present petition is dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.
